description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [Tactical Awoken Mode], [Tactical Awoken Mode: Terra (Wind)], [MAG +500 (25s) (Tactical)] to user.

description.name: Mode
description.text: Wind abilities deal 30% more damage, have +10,000 damage cap, deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, trigger 2 additional times, have zero hone cost, triggers [ATB_10%] after using Wind abilities while in Tactical Awoken Mode; removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Weapon Skill
description.text: One single attack (31.00 each) capped at 199,999. Grants [Wind Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Wind 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Wind Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)], [Quadracast Wind (Tactical) 1] to user if Level 2+ EnWind, grants [Attach Wind 2 with Stacking] to user if not.

description.name: Wind Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)
description.text: Increases the damage/healing cap for Wind attacks by 20000, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Wind 125% ATB Quick Cycle (Tactical)
description.text: Grants [125% ATB 1] after using a Wind ability, removed if the user hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: 125% ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x1.25

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Wind Ability +50% Boost (Tactical)
description.text: Wind abilities deal 50% more damage, removed if the character hasn't [Tactical Awoken Mode]

description.name: Quadracast Wind (Tactical) 1
description.text: Wind abilities trigger three additional times.

description.name: Attach Wind 2 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 2 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3
